description: Returns example slides from real pre-seed, angel and seed pitch decks, filtered by section, stage, outcome, reviewer verdict or words. Use it to show what a section looks like in practice; get section ids from list_sections. Only slides with an image are searched. Results are spread across decks: each deck contributes its first matching slide before any deck contributes a second. The result has total (all matches) and slides; each slide has its deck summary, n, position ("n of slide count"), section, section_name, label, image_url, and any verdict, review_point and review_note. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

limit.description: How many slides to return, 1 to 30. Defaults to 10; total still counts every match.

outcome.description: How the raise went. "funded" is decks that raised the round; "failed" covers rounds that did not close and first versions that investors rejected. Leave out for both.

query.description: Words to look for, case-insensitive. A slide matches when every word appears somewhere in its company name, slide label, review point or note, section name or stage name. Words match parts of words too ("pay" matches "payments").

section.description: Only slides of this section. The ids are the ones list_sections returns; "other" is slides that fit no section.

stage.description: Round stage. "early" is pre-seed and angel rounds; "seed" is seed rounds. Leave out for every stage.

verdict.description: Only slides a reviewer or the founder commented on: "praised" for slides called good, "criticised" for slides called weak. Leave out for all slides.

name: search_slides
title: Search slides
